notes.title: Japanese translation added!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I'm writing a quick post to let you know that Sweetest Monster has been translated into Japanese by Ichisan!
I'm very happy that even more people can have a chance to meet Bell and Robin. I hope you enjoy reading their story!
As always, please let me know if you find any bugs in this build, and I will try to fix them within a reasonable time frame.
Thank you everybody for reading Sweetest Monster; your support is always appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: Spanish translation added
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm writing a quick post to let you know that I've uploaded a new build of Sweetest Monster (after all these years... Wow…)

This new build fixes a couple of typos that were present in the English text, and (more importantly) adds a full Spanish translation to the VN courtesy of Aarón Acencio.

Aarón also translated my other short, dark VN, The Mermaid of Zennor, into Spanish, so you can check that out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502520]here[/url] if you're interested!

Bell can now speak in six languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese. That's very impressive. She's quite the polyglot!

I hope you enjoy the new build, and thank you very much for all of the support thus far. It's very much appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: German Translation
notes.content:
A new build of Sweetest Monster has been uploaded to Steam, which includes a full German translation, a couple of typo fixes in the English script, and some minor edits to the UI to make it look slicker.

Thank you to everybody for all your support. It is because of you I’ve been able to translate this visual novel into so many languages, and it’s most appreciated!

As always, please let me know if you find any problems. I’ll try to fix them ASAP.

- ebi x

notes.title: French translation
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

I recently uploaded a new build of Sweetest Monster to Steam, which includes a full French translation of the story by [url=https://twitter.com/herclinze]Herclinze[/url]! 
It's kind of amazing that this VN is now available in four different languages... I never expected this would happen, but I'm very thankful!

This build also contains a small edit to the Russian translation, to correct a minor bug.

If this update does anything strange to the game, such as breaking achievements, please let me know. It would be appreciated!
If you find any typos, errors, or anything of the sort, feel free to point those out, too!

Thank you,
- ebi x
